name: Garden Restaurant
why_it_matters: Kausani's most-cited independent restaurant on TripAdvisor — outdoor garden seating opposite Hotel Uttarakhand on Bhataria Road, with valley views. One of the few non-hotel kitchens in town doing both local aloo ke gutke and standard north-Indian comfort food well.
insider_tip: Order the local aloo ke gutke (potatoes tempered with jakhya seeds) instead of the continental items — the kitchen leans Kumaoni even when the menu pretends otherwise.
signature_address: Opposite Hotel Uttarakhand, Bhataria Road, Kausani 263639, Bageshwar District, Uttarakhand

name: Yogi Restaurant
why_it_matters: A 4-5 table family-run kitchen on Kausani's small Mall Road — about 2 km from the KMVN Trishul. Cooks prep everything to order in front of you, which is why the breakfast queue starts at 7am sharp. The cheapest sit-down meal in town.
insider_tip: Open 7am-9:30pm but the kitchen is sharpest at breakfast — order parathas off the tava rather than picking from the lunch menu.
signature_address: Mall Road, Kausani 263639, Bageshwar District, Uttarakhand

name: Annapurna Restaurant
why_it_matters: One of the few Kausani restaurants that actually leads with the Kumaoni thali rather than treating it as a token regional add-on — black bhatt dal, jhangora kheer, mandua roti, all on one plate. Located on the road towards Baijnath, away from the Mall Road tourist strip.
insider_tip: Order the thali, not the à la carte menu — the kitchen's strength is the millet-and-lentil combo plate, and the per-item prices don't make sense once you compare.
signature_address: Baijnath Road, Kausani 263639, Bageshwar District, Uttarakhand

name: Vaibhav Restaurant (Krishna Mountview)
why_it_matters: The in-house multi-cuisine restaurant at Krishna Mountview — Kausani's best-known mid-tier hotel, 5 minutes' walk from Anasakti Ashram. Open to walk-in non-residents; the terrace looks straight at the Trishul-Nanda Devi line.
insider_tip: Walk-ins are allowed but call ahead during peak season (Apr-Jun, Oct-Nov) — they prioritise residents on the Kumaoni thali set menu.
signature_address: Krishna Mountview Mountain Resort, Near Anasakti Ashram, Kausani 263639, Bageshwar District, Uttarakhand

name: Pratiksha Himalayan Retreat Restaurant
why_it_matters: Terrace restaurant at Pratiksha Himalayan Retreat, ranked #3 of 20 Kausani B&Bs on TripAdvisor with 28+ restaurant-specific reviews. The view-and-food combination is what locals send paying-visitors to when their hotel kitchen is mediocre.
insider_tip: Non-residents are welcome — book the terrace, not the indoor section. The breakfast spread is the most consistent meal of the day.
signature_address: Pratiksha Himalayan Retreat, Kausani 263639, Bageshwar District, Uttarakhand

name: Hotel Uttarakhand Restaurant
why_it_matters: The in-house restaurant at Hotel Uttarakhand — one of Kausani's older small hotels, 30 metres from the centre on Bhataria Road. Indian, à la carte, and Italian-style breakfast options including local pahari specials and bakery items. Reliable when the Mall Road dhabas are full.
insider_tip: The breakfast is open to non-residents from 7:30am-10am — order the pahari thali version if you want millet roti, otherwise it's a continental spread.
signature_address: Hotel Uttarakhand, Bhataria Road, Kausani 263639, Bageshwar District, Uttarakhand

name: KMVN Trishul Tourist Rest House Restaurant
why_it_matters: The state-run Kumaon Mandal Vikas Nigam (KMVN) Trishul guesthouse runs a multi-cuisine all-day vegetarian dining hall — government-set prices, simple menu, the dependable fallback when private kitchens are closed off-season. 3.9 stars on TripAdvisor.
insider_tip: Walk-in non-residents are accepted but the kitchen does NOT do room service — eat in the dining hall. Menu shrinks dramatically Nov-Mar; call ahead in winter.
signature_address: KMVN Tourist Rest House Trishul, Kausani 263639, Bageshwar District, Uttarakhand
